contentIdAlgorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON (no whitespace, emit Unicode), an array sorted by URL UTF-8 bytes with tuples [url, role, bytes, sha256]. Times and HTTP diagnostic metadata do not participate. URL and role bind identity even when bytes are equal.
scope: Production SDK JS and bootstrap, map worker, CSS, official documentation/example application, and render dependencies observed in the Seoul scenario. Documentation-only scripts, geographic data, and underlying JS engine members have distinct roles.
